headline: Strings, polar film, and a basement of standup
summary: Tuesday leans classical and cinematic: a string quartet at the Playhouse, a marimba-and-cello duo at 240 Northern, and mountaineering films at the Rio. If you would rather sit in a small room and laugh, the weekly standup night at China Cloud is on too. Campus gets a rare-books session and an artist talk on the Drexciya mythos, both easy to walk into.
summary_zh: 今天偏古典与影像：Playhouse 的弦乐四重奏、240 Northern 的马林巴＋大提琴二重奏，以及 Rio 剧院的极地登山影展；想笑的话，China Cloud 的周二脱口秀照常开演。UBC 那边还有善本特藏和 Drexciya 主题的对谈。

events.title: Terra String Quartet
events.note: A full chamber programme from a young quartet, in one of the city's proper concert halls.

events.title: VIMFF Extreme Antarctica
events.note: The mountain film festival's polar programme on the Rio's big screen — ice, wind and expedition footage.

events.title: Stick&Bow — Marimba & Cello duo
events.note: An unusual pairing in a small room — chamber music for people who want something off the usual programme.

events.title: The Tuesday Show: standup comedy
events.note: A weekly standup night in a small Main Street room. The kind of show where the room is half the joke.

events.title: From the Deep: In the Wake of Drexciya with Ayana V Jackson
events.note: An artist talk on the Drexciya mythos and its afterlife in contemporary art — and it's on campus.

events.title: Getting to know Rare Books and Special Collections at UBC
events.note: An introduction to UBC's rare books vault. Worth it if old paper and odd archives are your thing.

events.title: First Nations Art / Applied Art + Design Combined Exhibition
events.note: A combined show running all week — an easy drop-in if you're near Yaletown.

events.title: No Brainer Trivia at Container
events.note: Brewery trivia. Bring a team, or stand near one until they adopt you.

events.title: AKASHI — award-winning feature at VIFF Centre
events.note: A festival feature getting a run at the VIFF Centre — the comfortable option for a film night.

events.title: An Evening with Renée Coughlin & Rebekah Hawker
events.note: Two songwriters sharing a bill in a record-store-sized room.
